title: The Old Joliet Prison: Built by the Men It Held

sources.what: May 22, 1858, fifty-three prisoners arrived to build the prison around themselves from local limestone; closed 2002
sources.who: Old Joliet Prison, Joliet Area Historical Museum

sources.what: built by convict labor starting in 1858; Blues Brothers opening; Leopold and Loeb

paranormal investigators say spirits have appeared on the stairwells

beats.text: The prisoners built the walls that held them.
beats.label: JOLIET, ILLINOIS
beats.credit: History: Old Joliet Prison (Joliet Area Historical Museum); CBS Chicago; AP

beats.text: In 1858, convicts began building the Joliet Prison, out of limestone quarried nearby.
beats.credit: Joliet Area Historical Museum; CBS Chicago; AP

beats.text: Leopold and Loeb, and Baby Face Nelson, all did time here.
beats.label: ITS INMATES

beats.text: It closed in 2002. You've seen it in The Blues Brothers.
beats.label: CLOSED

beats.text: But a tour guide and some paranormal investigators say something is still inside.
beats.label: WHAT PEOPLE SAY

beats.text: In 2018, a visitor's photo seemed to show a woman in white, floating in the prison yard.
beats.label: THE WOMAN IN WHITE

beats.text: Today, the Joliet Area Historical Museum runs seasonal tours. Check dates before you go.
beats.label: TODAY

factcheck.result: 'tour guides and ghost hunters' narrowed to one tour guide and some paranormal investigators (the museum's historian doesn't believe it); 'did time here'; tours 'seasonal, check dates'; searchlight off (closed prison); all supported (the 2018 photo is from one outlet, WBEZ, told as 'seemed to show')
